message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` runs one test and it passes.

**Cause:** The migration `migrations/001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. The insert threw `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** I changed `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname`, the name the already-applied migration uses. That is two lines, in `createUser` and `getUser`. I left `migrations/` untouched, as you asked.

I did not commit anything. The working tree has the one-file change in `src/api/users.js`.
